```{r load-cleaned-data}
accidents <- readRDS("clean_accidents.rds")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r anova-all-weather, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# # Anova no grouping to other
# 1) Build clean two-column data.frame in base R
df_all <- data.frame(
  severity          = accidents$severity,
  weather_condition = accidents$weather_condition,
  stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
)
df_all <- na.omit(df_all)   # drop any rows with NA in either column

# 2) Subsample 1000000 rows at random
set.seed(2025)
if (nrow(df_all) > 1000000) {
  df_sub <- df_all[sample(nrow(df_all), 1000000), ]
} else {
  df_sub <- df_all
}

# 3) Run the one-way ANOVA
aov_all <- aov(severity ~ weather_condition, data = df_sub)
print(summary(aov_all))

# 4) Tukey HSD post-hoc
tukey_all <- TukeyHSD(aov_all)

# 5) Pull out the weather_condition table, rank by absolute mean-difference
tukey_df <- as.data.frame(tukey_all$weather_condition)
tukey_df$comparison <- rownames(tukey_df)
tukey_df <- tukey_df[order(-abs(tukey_df$diff)), ]

```

```{r}
# Show the top 10 largest differences
head(tukey_df, 10)
```


```{r}
# Show entire tukey HSD post-hoc
tukey_all <- TukeyHSD(aov_all)

# convert the weather_condition table into a data.frame
tukey_df <- as.data.frame(tukey_all$weather_condition, 
                          row.names = NULL,
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# add a column of comparisons
tukey_df$comparison <- rownames(tukey_all$weather_condition)

# reorder columns
tukey_df <- tukey_df[, c("comparison", "diff", "lwr", "upr", "p adj")]

# print it all
print(tukey_df, n = nrow(tukey_df))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

# Limit to top 10 most frequent conditions
top10 <- df_sub %>%
  mutate(weather_top10 = fct_lump(fct_infreq(weather_condition), n = 10)) %>%
  filter(weather_top10 != "Other")

# Violin + boxplot
ggplot(top10, aes(weather_top10, severity)) +
  geom_violin(fill="#4C72B0", alpha=0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1, outlier.size=0.5) +
  labs(title="Severity by Top 10 Weather Conditions",
       x="Weather Condition", y="Severity") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Compute means and CI for top10
grp <- top10 %>%
  group_by(weather_top10) %>%
  summarize(
    m = mean(severity),
    se = sd(severity)/sqrt(n())
  )

ggplot(grp, aes(weather_top10, m)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=m-1.96*se, ymax=m+1.96*se), width=0.2) +
  labs(title="Mean Severity ±95% CI: Top 10 Conditions",
       x="Weather Condition", y="Mean Severity") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))
```

```{r}
# Anova with grouping to get rid of rare conditions
# 1) Filter out NAs and immediately sample 1000000 rows
set.seed(2025)
acc_sample <- accidents %>%
  filter(!is.na(severity), !is.na(weather_condition)) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 1000000)

# 2) Create the 5‐level weather group on the much smaller sample
df_grouped <- acc_sample %>%
  mutate(
    weather_grp = case_when(
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("rain",   ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Rain",
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("snow|sleet|ice|hail", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Snow/Ice",
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("clear|fair", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("cloud|overcast", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Cloudy",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# 3) Exlude other conditions 
df_grouped <- df_grouped %>% filter(weather_grp != "Other")

# 4) Check counts per group
print(table(df_grouped$weather_grp))

# 5) Run one‐way ANOVA on these 5 groups
aov_grp <- aov(severity ~ weather_grp, data = df_grouped)
print(summary(aov_grp))

# 6) Tukey HSD for those 5 levels
tukey_grp <- TukeyHSD(aov_grp)
print(tukey_grp)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(df_grouped, aes(weather_grp, severity)) +
  geom_violin(fill="#4C72B0", alpha=0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1) +
  labs(title="Severity Distribution by Broad Weather Groups",
       x="Weather Group", y="Severity") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Recompute group means & SE
gm2 <- df_grouped %>%
  group_by(weather_grp) %>%
  summarize(
    m  = mean(severity),
    se = sd(severity) / sqrt(n())
  )

# Compute zoom limits
ymin <- min(gm2$m - 1.96 * gm2$se) - 0.005
ymax <- max(gm2$m + 1.96 * gm2$se) + 0.005

# Plot with zoomed y-axis
ggplot(gm2, aes(weather_grp, m)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4C72B0") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = m - 1.96*se, ymax = m + 1.96*se),
                width = 0.2) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(ymin, ymax)) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Severity ±95% CI by Broad Weather Groups (Zoomed)",
    x     = "Weather Group",
    y     = "Mean Severity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```
```{r}
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)

# Get estimated marginal means and CLD letters

# Plot with points, error bars, and CLD letters

  geom_text(aes(label = .group), vjust = -1.2, size = 5) +
  labs(
    title = "Tukey CLD with 95% CI: Broad Weather Groups",
    x = "Weather Group",
    y = "Mean Severity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```

```{r}
# ANOVA just for Rain
library(dplyr)

# 1) Flag any precipitation
df_rain <- accidents %>%
  filter(!is.na(severity), !is.na(precipitation_in)) %>%
  mutate(rain_flag = precipitation_in > 0)

# 2) Balanced subsample: equal number of dry and wet crashes
set.seed(2025)

min_n <- df_rain %>%
  count(rain_flag) %>%
  pull(n) %>%
  min()

df_rain_sub <- df_rain %>%
  group_by(rain_flag) %>%
  slice_sample(n = min_n) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3) Compare means: t-test
t_res <- t.test(severity ~ rain_flag, data = df_rain_sub)
print(t_res)

# 4) Equivalent ANOVA
aov_rain <- aov(severity ~ rain_flag, data = df_rain_sub)
print(summary(aov_rain))

```
```{r}
ggplot(df_rain_sub, aes(x = rain_flag, fill = factor(severity))) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(x = "Rain Condition", y = "Proportion", fill = "Severity") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Dry", "Wet")) +
  ggtitle("Crash Severity Composition: Dry vs Wet Conditions") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

df_rain_sub %>%
  group_by(rain_flag) %>%
  summarise(mean_sev = mean(severity),
            se = sd(severity)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  mutate(rain_flag = factor(rain_flag, labels = c("Dry", "Wet"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rain_flag, y = mean_sev, fill = rain_flag)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_sev - 1.96*se, ymax = mean_sev + 1.96*se),
                width = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "Rain Condition", y = "Mean Severity",
       title = "Mean Crash Severity ± 95% CI") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4C72B0", "#DD8452")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggplot(df_rain_sub, aes(x = factor(rain_flag), y = severity, color = rain_flag)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.05, width = 0.2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#4C72B0", "#DD8452"), labels = c("Dry", "Wet")) +
  labs(x = "Wet?", y = "Severity", title = "Crash Severity by Rain Condition (Jittered)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

# Two way Anova (Weather vs time of day on severity)
```{r}
# 1) Start from the same 1M-row sample you used before
set.seed(2025)
df2 <- accidents %>%
  filter(!is.na(severity), !is.na(weather_condition)) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 1000000)

# 2) Create your four-level weather_grp
df2 <- df2 %>%
  mutate(
    weather_grp = case_when(
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("rain", ignore_case=TRUE)) ~ "Rain",
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("snow|sleet|ice|hail", ignore_case=TRUE)) ~ "Snow/Ice",
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("clear|fair", ignore_case=TRUE)) ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("cloud|overcast", ignore_case=TRUE)) ~ "Cloudy",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(weather_grp != "Other")

# 3) Define time_of_day
df2 <- df2 %>%
  mutate(hour = hour(start_time),
         time_of_day = case_when(
           hour >= 5  & hour < 12 ~ "Morning",
           hour >= 12 & hour < 17 ~ "Afternoon",
           hour >= 17 & hour < 21 ~ "Evening",
           TRUE                  ~ "Night"
         ))

# 4) Fit the two-way ANOVA
two_way <- aov(severity ~ weather_grp * time_of_day, data = df2)
summary(two_way)

# 5) If the interaction is significant:
interaction.plot(df2$time_of_day, df2$weather_grp, df2$severity,
                 ylab="Mean Severity", xlab="Time of Day",
                 trace.label="Weather")

# 6) Post-hoc (if you want pairwise within each time block)
library(emmeans)
emmeans(two_way, pairwise ~ weather_grp | time_of_day)
```
```{r}
interaction.plot(df2$time_of_day, df2$weather_grp, df2$severity,
                 ylab="Mean Severity", xlab="Time of Day",
                 trace.label="Weather")
```

```{r}
 #  Line Plot of Means ± 95% CI by Time + Weather
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time_of_day, y = mean_sev, group = weather_grp, color = weather_grp)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_sev - 1.96*se, ymax = mean_sev + 1.96*se),
                width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Crash Severity by Weather and Time of Day",
    x = "Time of Day",
    y = "Mean Severity",
    color = "Weather"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```

```{r}
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)

mat4 <- tapply(df2$severity, list(df2$time_of_day, df2$weather_grp), mean)
long4 <- melt(mat4, varnames=c("time_of_day","weather_grp"), value.name="mean_sev")

ggplot(long4, aes(weather_grp, time_of_day, fill=mean_sev)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name="Mean Severity") +
  labs(title="Heatmap: Severity by Weather & Time") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(two_way, which=1); plot(two_way, which=2)
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
```


```{r}
# 0) Common setup: sample once, keep a ~1M-row data.frame
set.seed(2025)

# Ensure you don’t request more rows than exist
n_sample <- min(1e6, nrow(accidents))

idx   <- sample(seq_len(nrow(accidents)), n_sample)
small <- accidents[idx, ]
```

# 1) Traffic Signal × Time of Day
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

df_signal <- small %>%
  transmute(
    severity,
    signal_flag   = traffic_signal,
    start_hour    = hour(start_time)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time_of_day = case_when(
      start_hour >= 5  & start_hour < 12 ~ "Morning",
      start_hour >= 12 & start_hour < 17 ~ "Afternoon",
      start_hour >= 17 & start_hour < 21 ~ "Evening",
      TRUE                                ~ "Night"
    )
  )

aov_signal_time <- aov(severity ~ signal_flag * time_of_day, data = df_signal)
summary(aov_signal_time)
```
```{r}
library(emmeans)

# Pairwise comparisons of signal_flag *within* each time_of_day block
emmeans(aov_signal_time, pairwise ~ signal_flag | time_of_day)
```

```{r}
library(reshape2)
library(viridis)
 mat5 <- tapply(df_signal$severity, list(df_signal$time_of_day, df_signal$signal_flag), mean)
 long5 <- melt(mat5, varnames=c("time_of_day","signal_flag"), value.name="mean_sev")
 ggplot(long5, aes(signal_flag, time_of_day, fill=mean_sev)) +
  geom_tile() + scale_fill_viridis(name="Mean Sev") +
  labs(title="Heatmap: Signal × Time") + theme_minimal(base_size=14)
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)

# Get group means and CI
signal_summary <- emmeans(aov_signal_time, ~ signal_flag | time_of_day) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Line plot with CI
ggplot(signal_summary, aes(x = time_of_day, y = emmean, color = signal_flag, group = signal_flag)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Mean Crash Severity by Traffic Signal × Time of Day",
       x = "Time of Day", y = "Mean Severity ± 95% CI",
       color = "Traffic Signal") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}

plot(aov_signal_time, which=1); plot(aov_signal_time, which=2)
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
```

# 2) Bump × Weather Group
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

df_bump <- small %>%
  transmute(
    severity,
    bump_flag         = bump,
    weather_condition
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    weather_grp = case_when(
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("rain",       ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Rain",
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("snow|sleet|ice|hail", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Snow/Ice",
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("clear|fair", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("cloud|overcast", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Cloudy",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(weather_grp != "Other")

aov_bump_weather <- aov(severity ~ bump_flag * weather_grp, data = df_bump)
summary(aov_bump_weather)
```

```{r}
emmeans(aov_bump_weather, pairwise ~ bump_flag | weather_grp)
```

```{r}

ggplot(bump_summary, aes(x = weather_grp, y = emmean, color = bump_flag, group = bump_flag)) +

  labs(title = "Mean Crash Severity by Bump × Weather Group",

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

# 4) Weekend vs. Weekday × Weather Group
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)

df_weekend <- small %>%
  transmute(
    severity,
    weather_condition,
    is_weekend = wday(start_time) %in% c(1, 7)  # Sunday=1, Saturday=7
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    weather_grp = case_when(
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("rain",       ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Rain",
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("snow|sleet|ice|hail", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Snow/Ice",
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("clear|fair", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Clear",
      str_detect(weather_condition, regex("cloud|overcast", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Cloudy",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(weather_grp != "Other")

aov_weekend_weather <- aov(severity ~ is_weekend * weather_grp, data = df_weekend)
summary(aov_weekend_weather)
```

```{r}
emmeans(aov_weekend_weather, pairwise ~ is_weekend | weather_grp)
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)

effect_sizes <- data.frame(
  Interaction = c(
    "Weather Condition (Raw)",     # One-way full condition
    "Bump × Weather Group",        # Two-way
    "Signal × Time of Day",        # Two-way
    "Rain Flag (Dry vs Wet)",      # One-way
    "Weather × Time of Day",       # Two-way
    "Weather Group (5-level)",     # One-way grouped
    "Weekend × Weather Group",     # Two-way
    "Twilight × Weather Group"     # Two-way
  ),
  Max_Diff = c(
    0.3756,  # Top Tukey HSD diff
    0.2495,  # Bump x Weather (Rain)
    0.1659,  # Signal x Time (Morning)
    0.1025,  # Dry vs Wet (t-test estimate)
    0.0826,  # Weather x Time (estimated range)
    0.0761,  # Clear vs Rain in grouped weather
    0.0559,  # Weekend vs Weekday (Cloudy)
    0.0281   # Day vs Night (Snow/Ice)
  )
)

effect_sizes <- effect_sizes %>% arrange(desc(Max_Diff))

ggplot(effect_sizes, aes(x = reorder(Interaction, Max_Diff), y = Max_Diff)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4C72B0") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Max_Diff, 3)), hjust = -0.1) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Maximum Estimated Crash Severity Differences",
       x = "Factor / Interaction",
       y = "Max Estimated Difference in Mean Severity") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}
library(fmsb)

# Use the same weather order across groups
weather_levels <- c("Clear", "Cloudy", "Rain", "Snow/Ice")

# Extract means from each emmeans summary (values from your post)
radar_df <- data.frame(
  Group = c("No Signal", "Signal (Yes)",
            "No Bump", "Bump (Yes)",
            "Weekend", "Weekday",
            "Day", "Twilight (Night)"),
  Clear    = c(2.235, 2.069, 2.185, 2.109, 2.213, 2.180, 2.180, 2.198),
  Cloudy   = c(2.234, 2.117, 2.234, 2.117, 2.282, 2.226, 2.230, 2.247),
  Rain     = c(2.250, 2.000, 2.250, 2.000, 2.289, 2.242, 2.249, 2.250),
  Snow_Ice = c(2.236, NA,    2.236, NA,    2.255, 2.232, 2.247, 2.219)
)

# Keep only rows with complete values
radar_df <- radar_df[complete.cases(radar_df), ]

# fmsb needs 2 bounding rows (max, min) before actual data
radar_ready <- rbind(
  max = apply(radar_df[,-1], 2, max, na.rm = TRUE),
  min = apply(radar_df[,-1], 2, min, na.rm = TRUE),
  radar_df[,-1]
)
rownames(radar_ready) <- c("Max", "Min", radar_df$Group)

# Draw chart
radarchart(radar_ready,
           axistype = 1,
           pcol = rainbow(nrow(radar_df)),
           plwd = 2,
           plty = 1,
           cglcol = "grey", cglty = 1,
           axislabcol = "black",
           caxislabels = seq(2.18, 2.30, 0.03),
           vlcex = 0.8,
           title = "Radar Chart: Mean Crash Severity by Condition × Weather")

legend("topright", legend = radar_df$Group,
       col = rainbow(nrow(radar_df)), lty = 1, lwd = 2, bty = "n")
```
